name: Routing confusion -> alias traversal -> LFI source read
goal: Exploit front/back routing disagreement to reach hidden paths, then walk into filesystem reads and PHP source/config disclosure.
preconditions: Front proxy with rewrite/header routing + origin app; or nginx static alias config.
impact: Access to hidden/admin paths and arbitrary file/source read (DB creds from config).

steps.purpose: Reach paths the front blocks (admin, debug) via alternate routing headers.
steps.on_success: Note which paths are reachable; hunt for filesystem-touching endpoints.
steps.on_fail: Headers stripped -> nginx alias traversal next; also try X-Rewrite-URL variants.

steps.purpose: Static alias misconfiguration lets /static../ escape into arbitrary directory reads.
steps.on_success: Directory-level reads -> step 3 for filter-bypassed file reads.
steps.on_fail: No alias -> generic traversal filters next.

steps.on_success: File reads confirmed -> step 4 for source/config.
steps.on_fail: Filter stronger -> encoding matrix (%2e%2e%2f, ....//, unicode), or PHP wrappers next.

steps.skill: web/PHP filter wrapper LFI base64 read
steps.purpose: php://filter base64 read of application/config source — DB creds and secrets land in-band.
steps.on_success: Creds feed admin panels shelf (phpMyAdmin/Adminer/H2) for the pivot.
steps.on_fail: Not PHP -> pure traversal reads of .env/.git targets (recon-secrets-to-cloud chain).

entry_points: WAF-blocked paths worth re-testing via confusion

recon.name: Routing header sweep
recon.how: X-Original-URL / X-Rewrite-URL / X-Forwarded-Host at every mirror; diff status/bodies.

recon.name: Alias misconfig probe
recon.signal: Directory listing or file content of parent.

recon.name: 404-source differential
recon.how: Compare 404 bodies across paths to infer which layer produced them (front vs origin).

recon.name: Wrapper acceptance
recon.how: php://filter, file://, data:// acceptance on any file-parameter endpoint.

variants: LFI->RCE via log poisoning/session files (documented variant)
pivot_hints: pair with xxe for parser-level reads
